edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production as set forth below. These responses are based on information presently known and are subject to Defendant’s continuing investigation and any applicable objections.

1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks information protected from disclosure by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, or any other applicable privilege or protection. Defendant’s specific responses are subject to these general objections to the extent applicable.

2. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving the foregoing objections or any specific objections, Defendant will produce non-privileged documents responsive to the requests, if any, in its possession, custody, or control.

3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent Defendant withholds responsive documents on the basis of privilege or other protection, Defendant will identify them in a privilege log in accordance with the applicable rules and any agreement of the parties.
4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to amend or supplement these responses as permitted or required by the applicable rules.
